name: Cheats
author: farfeduc
description: Cheats you switch on and off while you play, from Cheats in the pause menu's Options: invincibility, infinite ammo, infinite oxygen under water, a bolt multiplier (x2 to x100), and buttons that refill every weapon's ammo and give 10,000 bolts. The settings here and the pause menu stay in step: a cheat switched in the game is saved here for the next start, and one changed here while the game runs is taken at once. A line in the HUD says which cheats are on.

settings.name: Invincibility
settings.description: Hits take no health. Falls out of the level and crushers still kill, as they do not hit Ratchet but end him at once.

settings.name: Infinite ammo
settings.description: Shots use no ammo. Switched on in the pause menu, it also fills every weapon you own.

settings.name: Infinite oxygen
settings.description: Ratchet never runs out of air under water, as with the O2 Mask.

settings.name: Bolt multiplier
settings.description: Each bolt you pick up counts this many times.

settings.name: Show the cheats in the HUD
settings.description: A small line at the bottom of the screen names the cheats that are on.

settings.name: Detailed log
settings.description: For bug reports: a line in the game's log for each cheat switched and each refill.
